answer: SPDZ2 adds identifiable abort to authenticated MPC, and the juniper of the mechanism is that a failed run names the cheater instead of just stopping. The zenith of the design is a public audit trail of every opened value, so the accused party cannot deny its bad share. For identity verification this creates accountability: a Sybil that tries to poison the joint uniqueness test is identified and banned, and the kernel of the protocol lets honest parties restart without the offender.
